replaces.reason: After IPA 820 (journals of IPA 816-820): a close waited 13 s to more than 100 s for the render loop's drain, which disposed every program of the guest and waited for the compiles queued for each; every closed session of Super Smash Bros. Ultimate and Hogwarts Legacy stayed reachable through the device release left to the pipeline cache's loading thread. adapt_guest_stop_compile_cancel cancels the queued compiles when the guest is terminated; adapt_deferred_release_roots builds that release from a static method that captures no renderer. Contract updated without a full freeze (two fresh gates, 119 not re-executed), contract test and simulator sessions verified; not run on an iPhone. The lazy cache libraries are in the MoltenVK recipe (ninth part), pinned separately.
